name: laya
description: Laya as a local provider for 5dive reflex: typed decisions made on your own box, with no API key.

verbs.name: laya
verbs.summary: set up, check or remove the local Laya provider behind 5dive reflex

setup.hint: Laya runs as one shared service on this box (127.0.0.1 only, no checkpoint preloaded), and reflex is pointed at it. Setup downloads Laya, CPU torch and one checkpoint (about 3 GB on disk) and needs Starter Plus (8 GB RAM) or larger. On Starter (4 GB), keep reflex on its remote provider. Undo everything with: sudo 5dive laya uninstall
